title: Bihar Election LIVE: HM Amit Shah Addresses Public Rally In Bhagalpur |NDA |RJD |CONG
description:
Bihar Election LIVE: HM Amit Shah Addresses Public Rally In Bhagalpur |NDA |RJD |CONG

Bihar Election LIVE:  Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed a massive public rally in Bhagalpur as part of the NDA's campaign for the Bihar Assembly Election 2025. The event saw an overwhelming crowd chanting 'Jai Shri Ram' and 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai', giving a grand welcome to the Home Minister. Shah launched a scathing attack on the Mahagathbandhan (RJD-Congress), accusing them of promoting dynasty politics, appeasement, and bringing back Jungle Raj, filled with crime, corruption, and infiltrators. He highlighted NDA's achievements under Nitish Kumar and PM Modi, including free ration for the poor, housing, toilets, electricity, water connections, women's safety, and bulldozer action against mafias. Shah urged voters to support NDA in the third phase on November 13, especially in Bhagalpur, to ensure a double-engine government for rapid development, job creation, and making Bihar the land of progress once again. The rally has given a major boost to the NDA's momentum in the Seemanchal region.

title: MODI LIVE : PM Modi Addresses Public Meeting At Darbhanga, Bihar | 2019 Election Campaign BJP
description:
MODI LIVE : PM Modi Addresses Public Meeting At Darbhanga, Bihar  2019 Election Campaign BJP
#ModiDarbhanga

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is coming to Bihar on an election tour once again. They will address the meeting in favor of BJP candidate of Darbhanga Gopalji Thakur. It is believed that its impact will affect the mathilanchal's political math.According to the information, the meeting of PM Modi will begin at 10 a.m. Chief Minister Nitish Kumar will also be there. BJP claims that the visit of PM Modi will be the communication of enthusiasm in Mithilanchal's political fight.Let us know that in the last elections, BJP had won two Mithilanchal seats. Kirti Azad from Darbhanga, Hukumdev Narayan Yadav from Madhubani elevated the BJP's flag.However, once the alliance is united by the alliance, the political equation seems to have changed slightly. But BJP is feeling a bit relieved by the arrival of Congress candidate Shakeel Ahmed in Madhubani.As per the program of PM Modi's Bihar tour, he will be at Darbhanga Airport at 9.55 in the morning. At 10 a.m., the meeting place will be departing for Raj Ground by road.They will arrive at the venue at 10.15 pm and they will be addressing people till 10.45 hrs. At 10.50 pm, Darbhanga Airport will be departing from the road. Darbhanga Airport will arrive at 11.05 hrs and at 1110 hrs the aircraft will fly from the IAF C-130 and reach Khajuraho Airport in Madhya Pradesh at 12.45 hrs.Tell that PM Modi will return to Bihar on April 30 and will address the meeting in favor of BJP candidate Ajay Nishad in Muzaffarpur.Before this, BJP national president Amit Shah will hold meetings in the favor of JD (U) candidate Sunil Kumar Pintu in Sitamarhi and in favor of Rajiv Pratap Rudy of Saran.
